notes: No official Meta MCP server found; only third-party MCP servers (e.g., github.com/quinnjr/threads-mcp) exist. Friction points: App Review required for production permissions (threads_basic, threads_content_publish, etc.), permission grants from public profiles last 90 days and cannot be extended for private profiles, short-lived tokens last 1 hour. Media for publishing must be hosted on a publicly accessible URL. Third-party blog reports the API is free but rate-limited, with no published paid tier.
